html:
The experience of diving to see corals under the sea is a sport chosen by many tourists, to see the sparkling and fascinating coral reefs. So let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the top 5 coral diving spots you should know right below.

Speaking of the sparkling and fascinating coral spots, we must mention Hon Mun Nha Trang coral, Phu Quoc coral, Con Dao coral and the indispensable coral diving spot is Da Nang coral, with colorful coral reefs that are chosen by many tourists.

Coral diving has the following forms:
Snorkeling
This is one of the popular forms of diving, chosen by many tourists. Before diving, you will be instructed and equipped with necessary tools such as life jackets, diving goggles, and underwater snorkels. You will be amazed to see the beauty under the sea, with sparkling and fascinating coral reefs.

Scuba Diving

This is a diving tool for tourists who want to explore the beauty deep under the sea. Tourists dive with oxygen tanks, fins, life jackets, and diving goggles and listen to the instructions of professional guides will bring you the most interesting experience.

In addition, you can also experience walking on the seabed of Nha Trang (Sea Walking)

Walking on the seabed is one of the most unique and beautiful experiences in every summer when the weather is hot, visitors walk on the seabed, immerse themselves in the clear blue water, watch the colorful coral reefs and schools of fish swimming around, which will bring visitors the most exciting feeling.

The beautiful Hon Mun Nha Trang coral captivates many hearts, many tourists come and experience diving to see the sparkling and fascinating coral reefs and record beautiful pictures for themselves.

Phu Quoc coral

Phu Quoc is famous for its coral reefs, including both hard and soft corals, growing close together in beaches with many brilliant colors. In particular, in An Thoi archipelago, there are many coral diving spots such as: Hon Thom, Hon Roi, Hon Dam, Hon Dua… the best time to experience coral diving in Phu Quoc is from May to July, when the sea is calm and the water is very beautiful.

Con Dao coral

Con Dao sea is so clear that visitors can see all the way to the bottom. When it comes to coral in Con Dao, we must mention Hon Bay Canh, Hon Tai, Hon Tre, Hon Trung, Hon Trac, Hon Cau… with different colors that will bring a unique beauty, making visitors feel excited.

To experience coral diving in Con Dao, visitors should rent a boat to the island, and rent coral diving services. The best time to dive in Con Dao is from March to September every year.

Coral diving in Da Nang

Da Nang has many beautiful coral diving spots. If you have the opportunity to travel Da Nang in the summer, you should experience coral diving to feel the unique beauty of the seabed. The first coral diving spot in Da Nang is Son Tra coral with colorful coral reefs. It is a destination chosen by many tourists as a stopover during each summer vacation.

The most beautiful coral in Son Tra is Hon Sun, where the beautiful colors will bring visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

Cua Lao Cham coral

A place where pristine beauty converges with magical sparkling coral reefs. The most beautiful time to travel to Cu Lao Cham is every summer when visitors can rent a canoe to go to the island and experience coral diving with magical sparkling coral reefs.

Cu Lao Cham Island has a spacious and airy conservation area with beautiful coral reefs of diverse colors. Visitors only need to dive about 3 meters or dive 6 meters below sea level to be amazed by the sparkling beauty.

Vinh Hy Bay Coral – Ninh Thuan

Vinh Hy Bay is a place that emerges like a pearl in the middle of the East Sea, with sparkling coral reefs. Visitors can both admire the beautiful natural scenery and experience scuba diving to see the sparkling coral.

Above are the beautiful coral viewing spots in the island paradise. If you are a lover of exploring the beauty of the ocean floor, come to this sea area once to see with your own eyes and admire the beauty of the sea floor with colorful sparkling coral reefs that will bring you the most exciting feeling.

In addition to the exciting experiences at sea, you can also enjoy fresh seafood such as lobster, king crab, and sea snails… bringing the delicious flavor unique to the island sea. To fully enjoy the beauty, visitors should come to the summer island paradise.
